about.title: About Nguyen CPA Firm
text: Nguyen CPA is a boutique, Houston-based CPA firm dedicated to bridging the often-disconnected worlds of taxes and finances. We specialize in helping physician business owners in the 30–50% tax bracket legally deduct six figures in taxes and implement proactive financial strategies to build lasting wealth—so they can focus on what matters most: living with purpose, creating impact, and building a life they love.

Leveraging her background as a Certified Public Accountant (CPA), a Certified Financial Planner (CFP®), and a Master’s degree in Finance, Haley brings a rare combination of credentials that allow her to assess, design, and implement advanced strategies for tax minimization, income optimization, wealth transfer, and legacy planning.

She believes using a holistic approach to connect the often-disconnected worlds of taxes and finances will put her clients —particularly physician business owners— in the best position to accumulate wealth and minimize taxes effectively.
